name: runtime-recovery
title: Make the render loop and asset loading recoverable
description: Fix the P0 runtime failures found in the codebase analysis: an exception inside renderFrame permanently stops the three.js WebGLAnimation loop, both module-level caches (RAPIER.init and the GLB model) cache rejections so one CDN hiccup bricks the page, reset has no re-entry guard, WebGL context loss is not handled at all, four window/document listener sets are never removed, THREE.Timer never connects the page-visibility guard, and resize rebuilds framebuffers on every event. Acceptance: injected exceptions and forced context loss both recover, a failed load can be retried from a visible error state, and listener register/unregister counts match.
creator: HelongZhou
